basic_info.description: Excelsior Excellence! Wonderful light & bright move-in ready updated single-family home with jumbo garden. Three bedrooms, two bathrooms + MEDIA room. Double-paned windows, sky lights, hardwood floors and two decks. The main floor features an updated kitchen, living room & dining area, 2 bedrooms, one with a view-deck and hall bathroom. The lower-level media room has a walk-out deck with access to the garden and an additional bedroom and full bathroom. Bonus storage and laundry hook-ups in garage. Wired for EV charger. Urban friendly with great transit and commute access in all directions. Established April 15, 1869, Excelsior is among the oldest and most culturally diverse SF neighborhoods.
